programme.title: The Travel Show
programme.desc: The Travel Show is a BBC travel programme. The new programme launched in February 2014,[1] and is the immediate successor of long standing travel programme, Fast Track. Utilising a network of correspondents in London, Tokyo, Sydney, New York and Kuala Lumpur, the programme aims to provide unique insight into the world of travel. It first aired in the UK in late February, after Winter Olympics coverage, in a Friday morning slot on BBC Two. A Sunday evening slot was also added on the BBC News channel in April 2014 and BBC iPlayer.

programme.title: Magnificat
programme.desc: When an elderly priest dies, it is revealed that she was a woman who secretly served for years and a bishop orders an investigation to uncover how and why such a deception was allowed.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: Louise Violet
programme.desc: France. End of the 19th century. Louise Violet, a Parisian teacher, is sent on a mission to the French countryside. She has to impose the free, compulsory and secular school of the Republic.

programme.title: Selma
programme.desc: Biopic chronicling the three-month period in 1965 which saw Dr Martin Luther King Jr lead a march from Selma to Montgomery. Despite the passing of the Civil Rights Act of 1964 which outlawed segregation, many black people still found they were being denied fundamental rights. In the face of extreme opposition from many who were determined to undermine their efforts, King and his fellow campaigners endured damaging smears and shocking physical attacks on the path to securing equal voting rights.

programme.title: The Fabulous Patars
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved spouse, Denis, a loving father, is struggling with the education of his two daughters, Jenine and Mercredi, and his two jobs. When he forgets to pick Mercredi up from school, the director calls the social services. Severine, a social investigator, forces Denis to attend parenting classes, under penalty of withdrawing the custody of his daughters…

programme.title: Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom
programme.desc: Biopic that sees Idris Elba play the South African lawyer who campaigned restlessly against apartheid in the 1940s before becoming one of the greatest leaders of the modern age. It chronicles Nelson Mandela's journey from childhood in a rural village, to prominent figure in a political movement striving for equality, to 27 years of imprisonment, and finally to his inauguration as South Africa's president.

programme.title: The Chef's Wife
programme.desc: The wife of a successful chef feels unfulfilled in her rôle as dining-room hostess and consults career counselor, who is herself dissatisfied by her useful but mundane place in the scheme of things. Without meaning to, the two women find their lives growing tangled together, with ever more complex tragicomic consequences.

programme.title: The Iron Lady
programme.desc: Meryl Streep won both a Best Actress Bafta and Oscar in the titular role of director Phyllida's biopic of the former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, who died recently. Writer Abi Morgan's script follows Thatcher's rise from modest beginnings to her role as Prime Minister, framed by a contemporary imagining of her later years, largely spent outside public scrutiny. The octogenarian Thatcher (Streep) is prompted to reminisce about her life and rise to power, as well as recalling her closest relationships, in particular that with her now-deceased husband Denis (Jim Broadbent). The young Margaret's (Alexandra Roach) ascendance in politics, inspired by her father, begins in the late 40s and takes her to the landmark moment in British history when she leads the Conservative Party to victory in the General Election of 1979, becoming the country's first female Prime Minister. Significant moments in recent history follow - from the Falklands War to the Miner's Strike and the Brighton Grand Hotel bombing - until finally, in 1990, she resigns and leaves 10 Downing Street. While it's impossible to completely eschew Thatcher's politics in a film of this nature - and politicians past and present had much to say on the film's portrait of the PM - the dramatisation is predominantly focused on the story of a woman who smashed gender and class barriers in a male-dominated world; and is ultimately an intimate portrait of an extraordinary and complex woman. Also starring Olivia Colman (as Carol Thatcher), Harry Lloyd (as a young Denis), Anthony Head (as Geoffrey Howe), Richard E Grant (as Michael Heseltine) and Roger Allam (as Gordon Reece). A Film4 co-production.

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: The lucky winner of the national lottery is Ned Devine, so taken by his good fortune that he now can't be waked, because he died from the shock of it! News of the win spread quickly in the scenic little Irish village of Tully More, but not the secret news of Ned's demise. With lottery officials closing in to confirm the prize claimed by the deceased Devine, Ned's closest friends scheme to keep the prize money close to home, in memory of Ned of course! But as the plot twists humorously, they learn it is hard is to keep such a secret in a small town.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship.

programme.title: The Disobedient
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement.

programme.title: The Integrity Of Joseph Chambers
programme.desc: Writer and director Robert Machoian's drama ponders the state of modern masculinity as a cack-handed insurance salesman played by Clayne Crawford heads solo to the woods for a fateful hunting trip. Joseph Chambers (Crawford) has moved his family to the depths of Alabama in search of a more wholesome life. Bent on proving - presumably to himself - that he's no city slicker, he decides to go hunt deer in a local wood. The wood belongs to his mate Doug (Carl Kennedy). In fact, so does the massive truck he's gonna drive to get there. Oh, and even the gun he's gonna shoot the deer with. His wife Tess (Jordana Brewster) isn't too happy about all this. She grew up in a hunting family, so none of this impresses her and she'd definitely do a better job of it than him. Anyway, when clueless Joseph goes stumbling round the woods with a loaded gun, will the result be anything good? Of course not, but just how not good is quite an eye-opener... Network Premiere.

programme.title: Food of Love
programme.desc: A group of ex-university students reunite to perform a Shakespeare play in a quaint English village.

programme.title: Meet the Penguins
programme.desc: Meet the Penguins is a documentary that follows the team of the Sancob Seabird Hospital in Cape Town, as they rescue penguins in need of help they encounter on the coast. These experts and volunteers give medical treatment, feed and support the incredible and vulnerable creatures, as they get ready to go back into the wild. Even when the odds are stacked the staff is dedicated to help the penguins get back on their feet. Meet the adorable characters of the penguins, each with a story of their own and a distinct personality.

programme.title: Animal Cribs
programme.desc: American animal TV series with designer Antonio Ballatore own show creating the perfect space for pet owning families. Believing that if dad can have a "man cave" and mum a "she shed" then surely there is such thing as a animal crib?! Antonio's passion for design and animals shines through throughout every episode. Joined by project manager Grace and their trusty companion Chewie the Bulldog they produce the most fantastic spaces for both pets and their owners. Pets include Chinchillas, dogs, cats and snakes and possibly many more.

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Reality series, set in Texas and similar to ''North Woods Law'', that follows daily lives of men and women who are Game Wardens and whose job is to protect deserts, lakes, woods, bayous, coasts and wild animals that live in the second-largest state in the U.S. These people have their plates full as they must deal with poachers, hunters who don't obey the law, smugglers, while they rescue injured wildlife and defend citizens.

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Alaskan Bush People is an American docudrama-style reality TV series revolving around the Brown family, members of which are trying to survive in the wilderness, far away from the society. Take a journey deep into Alaska's bush, where naturalist and adventurer Billy Brown, along with his wife, Ami, and their seven children, choose to live life on their own terms, connected to wild nature and bonded to each other.

programme.title: How Do Animals Do That?
programme.desc: How Do Animals Do That is a documentary series where experts answer various questions about the animal kingdom, revealing some amazing fun facts along the way. Animals have super powers humans can only dream of, they can do incredible things. The series provides answers to the questions how they do it and why. Find out why moths are attracted to flames, why turtles cry, why sea otters bond with stones, and why dogs wag their tails.

programme.title: Animal Cops: Houston
programme.desc: Animal Cops - Houston is the third Animal Planet series to follow the work of animal cruelty investigators. This particular series follows the animal cruelty investigators of the Houston Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (HSPCA). This team of 8 investigators works in a large area of Texas investigating reports of animal cruelty and, when necessary, removing animals from horrible abuse situations. Since these investigators do not have arrest or warrant seeking powers on their own, they work closely with local law enforcement, including the Harris County Precinct One Constable's Office. This office has permantly assigned Deputy Constable Christine Kendrick to assist the HSPCA investigators with any law enforcement issue that arises, including seeking warrents and arresting those charged with animal cruelty.

programme.title: Amba the Russian Tiger
programme.desc: Gordon Buchanan searches majestic Vladivostok for the Russian Tiger and meets the people who live with these elusive beasts.

programme.title: Cats of Claw Hill
programme.desc: Cats of Claw Hill is an amazing documentary series revolving around the magic world of cats, their private lives and their everyday routine. People have no idea what's going on when they are not at home. So this series gives the viewers a look at the secret lives of their cats, their scandals, anarchy and reveals cats' true faces. The feline lives are filmed from a cat's eye view in six different households. The cats do their regular cats stuff, patrol the streets and explore their residence, visit the vet. The series is a great source of informative, scientific data about the complex world of cat behaviour.

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

programme.title: Jeremy Wade's Dark Waters
programme.desc: Join biologist and angling expert Jeremy Wade as he travels the world peering through our darkest, murky waters, investigating tales of mythical monsters, mutated beasts and depleting fish populations. The star of River Monsters is back to explain the unexplainable, as he investigates these reported sightings of unknown creatures. Whether it's Lake Garda's reptilian monster, a species of pike the size of a man, a river monster deemed extinct in the Outback or South Africa's fabled half-man, half-fish monster, Jeremy will need to use all of his experience if he is to catch, or even glimpse, these creatures.

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

programme.title: My Cat from Hell
programme.desc: Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

programme.title: Insane Pools Off the Deep End
programme.desc: Insane Pools: Off the Deep End is a home improvement show that follows pool designer Lucas Congdon and his team from Lucas Lagoons. Congdon and his crew renovate existing pools and build new ones on residential properties. Thanks to their unbelievable imagination, creativity and professionalism they can turn every pool into an ultimate backyard oasis for a whole family and transform it into a natural lagoon. They prefer working with hand-selected stones from Tennessee.

Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

programme.title: The Last Alaskans
programme.desc: The Last Alaskans chronicles the daily rituals of four families choosing to live in seclusion, vast distances from each other as they overcome harsh arctic conditions, frustrating setbacks, and aggressive wildlife while they survive in one of the last great unspoiled and unforgiving wildernesses on the planet. In the refuge, prop planes, canoes and dog sleds replace the modern luxuries that most people take for granted. Humans cohabit with the animal world and often share the same emotions and struggles while they discover that they are not necessary at the top of the food chain. Utilizing an authentic and organic approach to document the weeks leading up to and during the winter season, The Last Alaskans sets a distinctive and vibrant tone unlike any other docu-series before to completely immerse the viewer into a world that would otherwise be lost in history.

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: A behind-the-scenes look at the Bronx Zoo, one of the largest zoos in the USA and the largest city zoo the country has to offer. Opening their doors to camera crews, the daily operations of the world-famous animal sanctuary are revealed, as the staff keep their loving creatures healthy and happy. Renowned for its diverse collection of animals and wonderful exhibitions, the Bronx Zoo is one of the finest in the world, home to lions, bears, tigers, snow leopards, baboons, flamingos and many more extravagant species. This series showcases the effort, experience and expertise required to run the Bronx Zoo.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue
programme.desc: This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

programme.title: Big Fish Man
programme.desc: World record-holding angler Jakub Vagner would die for fishing and has come close more than once. In Big Fish Man he embarks on extreme fishing expeditions to the most remote regions of the world in search of fish that have never before been filmed in the wild many weighing more than 200kg and measuring over six metres in length. His exploits take us to a variety of remote locations Congo, Mongolia, Europe, Canada, Thailand, Ecuador and Peru. Carrying all his kit and supplies, Jakub spends days trekking through unforgiving jungle and paddling against wild river currents. He survives using the hunting and foraging skills hes honed over almost two decades of fishing missions. On his visually stunning adventure he tries to land the Amazons largest freshwater fish in Ecuador and the mighty Goliath Tiger Fish, with its 32 shark-like teeth, in Congo. He enlists the help of nomadic reindeer herders to land a giant Taimen in the ice cold rapids of the Shishgid River in Mongolia and tries to catch a massive Northern Pike in the Canadian sub-Arctic even though their natural habitat is completely frozen over. The series is packed with drama and danger. Jakub is stubborn and determined as time after time he faces nature at its most extreme.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is cleaning out her kitchen by turning leftovers into amazing dishes. She starts in the pantry with Brown Sugar Buttermilk Waffles with a sensational brown sugar syrup and uses her frozen odds and ends to build a perfect Cheesy Freezer Chicken Pot Pie. Then, the fridge scraps are in the spotlight in a Loaded Egg Salad Sandwich, and a final run through the pantry turns into a Bean and Bacon Soup, a well-earned lunch for Ladd, who's spending the morning moving cattle.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Haunting In The Heartland
programme.desc: Something evil lurks in the shadows of the close-knit communities, idyllic Main Streets and rolling fields of America's heartland. Paranormal investigator Steve Shippy witnessed this darkness firsthand as a child growing up in rural Michigan. Now, with the help of local eyewitnesses and historical records, he's made it his mission to solve these mysterious hauntings and bring resolution to the living and the dead.

programme.title: Haunted Towns
programme.desc: The TWC team (Tennessee Wraith Chasers) travel across the US to investigate stories of hauntings and horrors, attempting to establish whether there are supernatural forces at play or if they're just folklore. The team is made up of Chris Smith, Steven McDougal, Scott Porter and Brannon Smith. Together they interview witnesses and gather evidence, uncovering the fact behind the fiction to decipher what or who is causing the hauntings. These paranormal places are scattered across America and have long claimed to have spooky pasts; the team hope they can solve the mysteries once and for all. Reality series.

programme.title: The Dead Files
programme.desc: On "The Dead Files," Cindy Kaza, an evidential medium, and Steve DiSchiavi, a retired NYPD homicide detective, join forces to investigate paranormal activity in haunted locations across the United States. Their unique talents combine to create a powerful team that aims to unravel the mysteries of the supernatural world. With a blend of psychic intuition and investigative skills, Kaza and DiSchiavi explored the boundaries between the living and the dead, seeking answers to unexplained phenomena that defy conventional explanations. Their captivating narratives offer viewers a glimpse into the uncharted territories of the afterlife, bridging the gap between this world and the next.

programme.title: Portals To Hell
programme.desc: Growing up around Ozzy Osbourne must have been, at times, a frightening ordeal for Jack Osbourne, however that hasn't stopped the son of the Prince of Darkness teaming up with paranormal investigator Katrina Weidman, to explore infamous, haunted locations. In each episode of this frightening reality series, Jack and Katrina head to a new place with a chilling history, and each sinister site is said to be a portal to the depths of the underworld. With the help of a team of experts and armed with unique technology, the pair thoroughly examine each new haunting site, hoping to unearth the truth behind their respective mysterious pasts.

programme.title: Expedition Bigfoot
programme.desc: Expedition Bigfoot is a documentary series exploring the possible existence of the fabled apelike creature. A primatologist, a survivalist, an author and a Bigfoot investigator team up, and set out into the Oregon forests to search for the hairy creature. With the help of advanced technology, like drones, algorithms and trail cameras, they try to find out if the old myth could be true. The series also includes interviews with eyewitnesses, as every year hundreds of people claim to have seen it.

programme.title: Edge of Alaska
programme.desc: Hidden deep in the wilderness of eastern Alaska and built during the Gold Rush as Alaska's original 'Sin City', only 42 residents currently brave the extreme conditions in McCarthy. It's an isolated outlaw town - a refuge for people who don't want to be found that's surrounded by extreme wilderness over 100 miles from the authorities where young men go to prove themselves and old outlaws go to die; hunters, gold miners, gunsmiths, and survivalists who reside in this 'Old West' town are willing to risk their lives to live truly free. While some believe in continuing the town's frontier way of life, others feel the future of McCarthy depends on dragging itself into the modern age. Which way of life will reign supreme?

programme.title: Finding Bigfoot
programme.desc: From small towns in the South to remote areas of the Pacific Northwest and Alaska, four eccentric but passionate members of the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) embark on one single-minded mission: to find the elusive "creature" known as Bigfoot or the Sasquatch. The team consists of Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization (BFRO) founder and President Matt Moneymaker, researchers James "Bobo" Fay and Cliff Barackman and skeptical scientist Ranae Holland. The series never questions the existence of Bigfoot, but rather documents the team's search efforts and study of evidence in an attempt to prove the existence of the elusive creature.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: Sister Wives
programme.desc: Kody Brown, with his four wives Meri, Janelle, Robyn and Christine and their combined 17 children, attempt to navigate life as a "normal" family in a society that shuns their lifestyle. From their unconventional family structure and living arrangements to financial challenges, each half hour episode exposes the inner workings of a polygamist household, revealing the unexpectedly tight-knit and loving relationships between Kody's wives. The series also captures the intense dynamics surrounding a man juggling three wives while attempting to keep it a secret from the outside world- but the general public is not the only challenge that the Brown family unit is facing.

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: My Feet Are Killing Me
programme.desc: Quarantining at home hasn't stopped everyone's favorite foot fixers from helping patients with their foot troubles. Dr. Brad and Dr. Ebonie are teaming up with the compassionate and intelligent Dr. Sarah Haller, who is joining the medical series and has been working alongside Dr. Brad for years, on all new episodes of MY FEET ARE KILLING ME: FIRST STEPS. In the midst of a world shutdown by COVID-19, these dynamic foot doctors pledge to help shocking podiatric cases, one video call at a time. Each 30-minute episode will follow three patients as they undergo virtual consultations to begin their journey towards surgeries that will leave their feet radically transformed and their lives changed forever. COVID toes have nothing on these cases!

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: United Airlines Flight #232 DC-10 July 19th, 1989 United Airlines Flight #232 is 37,000 feet over Iowa when one of its three engines explodes. The pilots shut it down but soon discover they have a much more serious problem on their hands. The plane is in a steep right bank, and the pilots are unable to restore its flight path. The DC-10 has suffered a complete failure of all hydraulic systems, and the pilots have no way to maneuver the plane other than by alternating the power to the two remaining engines. The pilots manage to fly the crippled plane to the nearest airport but, unable to configure the wings for a normal landing, they have no choice but to keep the engines at nearly full power. After a crash that claims 111 of the 296 people on board, it's up to investigators to figure out how a foolproof system failed.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: Space shuttle Columbia, the Deepwater Horizon oil rig, and the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant are three major disasters linked to engineering and design flaws. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design choices that turned failures into catastrophes. What turned Columbia's return into a disaster? Why didn't the oil rig's final defenses hold? And how did a massive wave defeat emergency backups?

programme.title: Disaster Autopsy
programme.desc: A construction crane in the heart of New York City, Italy's iconic Morandi Bridge, and a multistory department store in Korea — three major disasters linked to engineering errors. Now, using the latest research and evidence along with 3D reconstructions, experts rewind the day of each disaster, dissect the chain of events, and pinpoint the warnings and design flaws that spiraled into structural collapse. How does a series of oversights, design flaws, and negligent decisions lead to deadly catastrophes?

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: The show that combines cold hard science with some of the craziest, most spectacular and painful user generated clips ever recorded is back for a third season. Richard Hammond introduces a host of new mishaps featuring brave, if misguided individuals from around the world and then explains the science behind their failure and humiliation with the use of bespoke animations and super slo-mo cinematography. Each week we show between 50 and 60 clips of misadventure - ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes. Each episode will feature several themes such as motorbike drifting, wakeboarding or attempting to fly drones. Clips are paused, re-wound, and re-played as we analyse exactly what went wrong and why. Richard Hammond explains the physics, chemistry and biology at play, by presenting forensic detail to explain the stupidity that resulted in failure. He'll study everything from acceleration to aero dynamics, fluid pressure to combustion and human anatomy to flammability. This is misadventure explained. This is The Science of Stupid.

programme.title: Dark Secrets of the Sun
programme.desc: It contains 99.9 percent of all the matter in our solar system and sheds hot plasma at nearly a million miles an hour. The temperature at its core is a staggering 27 million degrees Fahrenheit. It convulses, it blazes, it sings. You know it as the sun. Scientists know it as one of the most amazing physics laboratories in the universe. Now, with the help of new spacecraft and Earth-based telescopes, scientists are seeing the sun as they never have before and even recreating what happens at its very center in labs here on Earth. Their work will help us understand aspects of the sun that have puzzled scientists for decades. But more critically, it may help us predict and track solar storms that have the power to zap our power grid, shut down telecommunications, and ground global air travel for days, weeks, or even longer. Such storms have happened before-but never in the modern era of satellite communication. "Dark Secrets of the Sun" reveals a bright new dawn in our understanding of our nearest star-one that might help keep our planet from going dark.

programme.title: The Infinite Explorer with Hannah Fry
programme.desc: Hannah Fry travels to Vietnam, a land of staggering natural beauty, ancient traditions and some of the fastest growing skylines on earth. Over 1,600 km from the vibrant South to the historic North, she uncovers the story of the country's remarkable post-war transformation. She immerses herself in the moped chaos in Ho Chi Minh City, helps with a muddy prawn harvest in the Mekong Delta and takes a restorative spa bath in the misty hilltops of Sapa. She ushers in the New Year with a local family celebrating the Tet festival and learns how a beloved dish, pho, tells a story of identity. In each place she visits, she meets characters whose lives have been shaped by both war and renewal. What emerges is a nation embracing change, where striking contrasts are balanced by a spirit of cooperation and strong family bonds.

programme.title: Amsterdam Central 24/7
programme.desc: SAIL Amsterdam is the largest nautical event in the world, held in the capital once every five years. Around 800 historic ships and impressive tall ships sail along the IJ River past Amsterdam Central Station. Amsterdam Central Station staff expects an additional 150,000 passengers, making it one of the busiest days of the year. To ensure the enormous influx of visitors doesn't lead to dangerous congestion, station manager René and safety coordinator Bas oversee crowd control. They have to pull out all the stops, especially after the fireworks show ends in the evening. For the Safety & Service team, it's all hands on deck. Menno and Baran are busy dealing with alcohol-related incidents of collapse and aggression.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: From CIA wife to CIA spy: The widow of a CIA officer, who was killed in action, chooses to take up the mantle, becoming the first woman to go undercover in Moscow and handle one of the most important Russian sources of the Cold War.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The real Jason Bourne: A former special forces soldier, now working as a CIA officer, is presented with the rare opportunity to meet face-to-face with a high-ranking enemy Taliban leader. But when a critical and trusted ally unexpectedly goes missing, he finds himself at a crossroads. He must decide whether he should embrace the warrior code and launch a rescue mission, even if it means walking straight into a carefully laid ambush.

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: History is full of revolutions, industrial, sexual and the big one, political. And each one starts in a different way. Every once in a while, holding hands and singing can be more effective than tanks and barricades. But even if your cause and motives are pure to begin with, how can you still end up on the wrong side of history?

programme.title: History: The Interesting Bits
programme.desc: Our modern world didn't just happen it was invented through inspiration, perseverance and dumb luck. We learn that great inventors often build their ideas on the shoulders of those that went before or just steal them. And it's not always clear who came up with every world changing invention, even TV.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. Yet decades after the fact, certain stories remain touched by an air of uncertainty. Investigate the truth behind some of history's greatest events and most iconic people. Discover new clues about the reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes; the CIA's top-secret experiments; the Unabomber and; little known stories from NASA's Apollo missions.

programme.title: History's Secrets
programme.desc: Mysterious events, compelling figures and great unanswered questions from the past are explored. Most historians have reached a consensus about the way major world events played out. Yet decades after the fact, certain stories remain touched by an air of uncertainty. Investigate the truth behind some of history's greatest events and most iconic people. Discover new clues about the reclusive billionaire Howard Hughes; the CIA's top-secret experiments; the Unabomber and; little known stories from NASA's Apollo missions.

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: In 1995, a bone of an extinct bear is found in a Slovenian cave that could rewrite our place in the story of evolution. The bone appears to be carved with intention by someone at least 10,000 years before humans arrived in that part of the world. Who made it and why? A simple black dress shoe sits in a glass case in the Heinz Nixdorf Museums Forum in Germany. The reason? More than just a shoe, this is a high-tech machine for its time, designed to do the impossible: beat the casino. And an intricate purple gemstone adorned with silver snakes, quartz scarabs and cryptic words, has a long history intertwined with illness, ruin, tragedy and death. Where did it originate, and could it really be cursed?

programme.title: Strangest Things
programme.desc: In 1898, a stunning object shows up at the British Museum. Carved and polished from a single piece of quartz, it is shaped like an immaculate human skull. Is this a creation of Mesoamericans, as originally claimed? Why is it rumoured to possess supernatural power? A gruesome-looking chair from ancient China, housed at the Wellcome Collection in London, is covered in sword blades, spikes and ornate decorations. Clearly, this is no love seat. Is it some kind of torture device, or more than meets the eye? From a long-buried library in the lost Assyrian city of Nineveh comes a peculiar round tablet scribbled with cuneiform writing. Is it the work of astronomers, proof of an ancient apocalypse, or a 3,000-year-old instruction manual?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Copa Airlines Flight 201 Boeing 737-200 June 6th, 1992 Copa Airlines Flight 201 takes off from Panama City for the one-hour flight to Cali, Colombia. But with a major storm on the horizon, the pilots revise their flight path to avoid the heavy weather. After 12 minutes in the air, the captain radios controllers to tell them they've reached their cruising altitude of 25,000 feet. But moments later, the plane disappears from radar over one of the remotest jungles on earth.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Arrow Air Flight #1285 DC-8 December 12th, 1985 - After a six-month peace-keeping mission in the Middle East, 248 elite American soldiers are on their way home for the holidays. Destined for Fort Campbell, Kentucky, they are travelling on Arrow Air Flight #1285, a charter air carrier contracted by the military to transport troops. En route from Cairo, the DC-8 eventually touches down for a routine refueling stop in Gander, Newfoundland. But just seconds after taking off again for the last leg of its journey, the plane loses airspeed and altitude and crashes into a heavily wooded area just south of the runway. An unprecedented disaster, it is one of the deadliest aviation accidents of all time and the resulting investigation ignites a storm of controversy that continues to this day.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: When the twin towers fell in 2001, many engineers thought the era of the skyscraper was over. But the extraordinary catastrophe marked a turning point of a different kind. Safety codes and new understandings were shared internationally, and enthusiasm for tall buildings reached new heights. Construction of supertall buildings — skyscrapers taller than 300 meters — accelerated. Now, there are 71 cities across the world with at least one. Each one, from the One World Trade Center in New York to the Burj Khalifa in Dubai, stands on the shoulders of past failures, hard lessons written in concrete and steel.

programme.title: Engineering by Catastrophe
programme.desc: Nuclear energy can power whole cities … or level them. Free from carbon emissions and capable of providing baseload power to the existing grid, nuclear is a key tool in the fight against climate change — but the potential for catastrophe is never far from public perception. Despite its reputation, atomic power is one of the safest forms of electricity generation in the world today, thanks to the engineering lessons learned from past accidents. Chernobyl, Fukushima and Three Mile Island have each provided a roadmap to a safer future as atomic scientists work on realizing the ultimate dream: nuclear fusion.

programme.title: Lost Treasures of the Bible
programme.desc: Exodus and the conquest of the land of Canaan are among the Bible's most famous stories. They tell how the Israelites triumphed, with the help of the Ark of the Covenant. The problem is that there is little archaeological evidence that these tales happened exactly as the Bible describes. Across the Holy Land, archaeologists and investigators dig through the ruins of ancient cities to uncover the real world behind the biblical accounts. Just west of Jerusalem, one team explores a cave tomb to reveal evidence for the origins of the Israelites' enemies, the Philistines. In northern Israel, another team excavates the remains of the Canaanite kingdom's mightiest stronghold and finds mysterious Egyptian artifacts that shed new light on the traditional tale of the Israelites' journey to what the Bible calls the Promised Land.

programme.title: Ancient Structures: Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Throughout history, the colossal monuments of our ancestors have embodied their determination to leave a lasting mark on the world. The Colosseum — a spectacular feat of engineering and design that once hosted violent spectacles for thousands — holds the secrets of Roman ingenuity. The serpentine expanse of the Great Wall of China, winding over 21,000 kilometers, conceals clues of its construction and surprising ingredients that not only fortify its strength but also reflect the resourcefulness of the builders charged with protecting an empire. Malbork Castle, the largest brick fortress in the world, showcases the military prowess of the Teutonic Knights. Its strategic design and defensive features hold untold stories of battles fought and won.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In 1924, construction crews in Washington, D.C., uncovered a labyrinth of tunnels beneath Dupont Circle. Once rumored to be part of a spy network or a Prohibition-era bootlegging route, it was ultimately traced to an entomologist who secretly excavated them. In Italy, archaeologists reveal the Tomb of Cerberus, a burial chamber sealed in volcanic rock. Decorated with mythological creatures, the tomb's exquisite preservation suggests it was built for a powerful Roman family. In Colombia, vast underground chambers carved into volcanic rock hide burial sites. Their intricate architecture and geometric murals hint at deep spiritual and ritual meaning. Finally, volunteers rediscover Joseph Williamson's tunnels beneath England, a sprawling, hand-dug network from the early 1800s and still one of history's greatest underground enigmas.

programme.title: Hidden Beneath the Cities
programme.desc: In Jordan, archaeologists make a stunning find: a sealed tomb containing 12 undisturbed skeletons dating to the height of Nabataean civilization. Artifacts and symbolic design suggest the chamber may have been a royal or priestly burial, though its secrecy hints at tragedy. In Scotland, excavations beneath a 17th-century hunting lodge reveal a hoard of 36 buried coins. Likely concealed during the 1692 Glencoe massacre, the find ties to the MacDonald clan and centuries of conflict. In Peru, gas workers uncover two pre-Incan tombs, one occupied and one empty. The burials, attributed to the Chancay culture, raise questions about ritual, symbolism and loss. Finally, in England, a 4,000-year-old oak log coffin reveals a Bronze Age leader with a ceremonial axe on a bed of plants.

programme.title: Inside North Korea: The Cyber State
programme.desc: North Korea can now attack without landing a soldier on the ground, and with impunity. From Sony to WannaCry, the North embraces cyber-crime for profit and disruption with a 6000 strong army of cyber criminals worldwide who pick its pockets.

programme.title: Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: The real Jason Bourne: A former special forces soldier, now working as a CIA officer, is presented with the rare opportunity to meet face-to-face with a high-ranking enemy Taliban leader. But when a critical and trusted ally unexpectedly goes missing, he finds himself at a crossroads. He must decide whether he should embrace the warrior code and launch a rescue mission, even if it means walking straight into a carefully laid ambush.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations along with Air and Marine Operations in Miami intercept a sailboat coming from Colombia with bricks of cocaine onboard. And at the mail facility, CBP Contraband Enforcement Team intercepts kilos of marijuana stuffed inside an ottoman. At Dulles International Airport, which serves Washington, D.C., a rookie K9 alerts on a passenger with suitcases full of THC oil jars and drug paraphernalia heading to Europe.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Homeland Security Investigations in Puerto Rico seized cocaine from an abandoned boat on the beach. In Texas, Customs and Border Protection officers uncovered packages of methamphetamine hidden within pallets from a large shipment of limes. With the drug pouches stuck to the wood, it takes them many hours to retrieve the load. At the Port of Newark, CBP discovers stolen vehicles concealed inside shipping containers about to be sent out of the country.

Erilise lapse kasvatamine avas mõlema vanema südamed, mistõttu suur osa nende ajast kulub vabatahtlikena teiste aitamisele. Pere kõige suurem mure on aga seotud pojaga. Pidevad luumurrud on aheldanud esimese klassi poisi ratastooli ja koduseinte vahele, kuid vanemate südamesoov on, et nende laps saaks käia koolis nagu kõik teised temaealised.

programme.title: Rannamaja remondihundid
programme.desc: Äge suhtesari "Rannamaja" pakub vaatajatele kuhjaga romantilisi suhteid ning pööraseid seiklusi! Kuus noort ja vallalist kolivad elama rannamajja ühe eesmärgiga – luua romantilisi suhteid ja leida omale kaaslane. Kui kokkukolinute hulgas sobivat paarilist ei ole, siis korraldatakse pidusid eesmärgiga leida kaaslane pidutsedes. Juba esimeses episoodis selgub, et osalistevahelised tunded võivad tekkida väga kiiresti ning sama kiirelt võib kogu olukord võtta ka dramaatilise pöörde.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Bradil ja Sarah'l on ühine muusikamaitse ja väärtushinnangud, mõlemad nõustuvad ka teise kohtinguga. Libbyl ja Nickil klappi ei teki - Nicki ülevoolav jutukus ja rahakoti kojuunustamine viivad Libby pisaraisse. Liam muudab pideva silma tegemisega Alicia närviliseks, kuid too otsustab talle siiski võimaluse anda. Mike ja Marek leiavad ühise keele, kuid Marek sõprusest kaugemale minna ei taha.

programme.title: Esmakohtingud. Austraalia
programme.desc: Clair ja Hansel tantsivad salsarütmides läbi oma kelmika kohtingu ja lepivad ka uue kohtamise osas kokku, kuigi selleni ei jõuagi. Mark on Laurast sisse võetud, aga Laura teist kohtingut ei soovi. Surfar Mikaela ja musklimees James tunduvad klappivat, aga Jamesi tiheda graafiku tõttu lükkub teine kohting edasi. Eliza kohmetu olek mõjub Alexile võluvalt ja mõlemad nõustuvad teise kohtinguga.

programme.title: Müts maha armastuse ees

Seltskonnadaam Rosalindile jäävad Stella disainid silma ja ta palkab Stella ratsavõistluse nädala jaoks kavandeid looma.

programme.title: Ilmvõimatu
programme.desc: Oscarile kandideerinud tõeliselt võimas ja kaasahaarav draama, mis põhineb ühe Hispaania perekonnaga juhtunud lool 2004. aastal. Maria (Naomi Watts, "21 grammi"), Henry (Ewan McGregor, "Trainspotting") ja nende lapsed puhkavad Tai kuurordis. Perekond lõõgastub basseini ääres ja tähistab jõulusid paradiisis, kuid siis tabab kuurorti metsik tsunami. Kogu rannik kaob ning algab võitlus loodusjõududega elu ja surma peale. Intensiivne ja emotsionaalne lugu osutus kassahitiks režissööri kodumaal Hispaanias ja seda saatis suur menu ka mujal maailmas, seda nii kinolevis kui festivalidel. Lavastas Juan Antonio Bayona ("Orbudekodu").

programme.title: Maailm täis luksust
programme.desc: Luksushotellid pakuvad külluslikku kogemust. Nende seas on St Lucia Jade Mountain ja hotell Metropole Monacos, kus ööbimine võib maksta lausa 200 000 naela. Londoni Lanesborough' hotell uhkustab haruldaste alkoholidega, samas kui Pariisis pakutakse vaateid endisest paleest.

programme.title: Sassis
programme.desc: Eesti 2022 aasta parima teleseriaali preemia pälvinud komöödia "Sassis" on tagasi! Peategelase Evelin Kassi elu on nüüd veel rohkem sassis. Me näeme nii palju piinlikke vahejuhtumeid, kiiksuga karaktreid ja kiiva kiskuvaid inimsuhteid, et piss tuleb püksi. Evelini ja Velle abielu on karidel. Rivaalitsemine ja ärategemine käib iga asja pärast - olgu selleks raamatud, maja või lapsed. Naine aga ei kavatsegi lahutusjärgsesse depressiooni langeda: raevuka tarmukusega katsetab ta uusi rõivaid, suhteid ja kasvatusviise. Nagu ikka, mida rohkem sa pingutad, seda suurem on risk kõik veelgi hullemini sassi ajada.

programme.desc: Vahva sari kolmeaastastest lastest ja nende parimast sõbrast Karu-Karlast. Karla on laste lemmikkaisukaru, kes ärkab ellu ainult siis, kui kedagi teist lähedal pole. Karla aitab väikestel põnnidel üle saada igasugustest hirmudest ja muredest, ning teeb seda parimal võimalikul viisil - killukese maagia ja kujutlusvõimega.

programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Luise ja Oliver
programme.desc: Luise ja Oliver on õde ning vend, kes elavad oma tavalist õe ja venna elu. Mängivad põnevaid mänge, õpivad uusi teadmisi ja tunnevad huvi, kuidas maailmas asjad käivad. Ja isegi kui mõni teema neid vaidlema paneb, leitakse sõbralikult koos lahendus igale küsimusele. Näitlejad Maarja Johanna Mägi ja Aaron Thor Härm, režissöör Kristo Veinberg, stsenarist Laura Kõrvits, produtsent Kadi Katarina Priske.

programme.title: Tuta asjad
programme.desc: Tuta ja Rebane on täna päris restorani köögis, et proovida olla peakoka rollis ning valmistada maailma maitsvaimat sidrunisufleed. Et magustoit saaks nämma, tuleb kasutada retseptis olevaid kõiki koostisosasid. Aga mida teha siis, kui suhkru asemel läheb käiku sool? Vaata ja maiusta koos Tutaga.

programme.title: Põrsas Peppa
programme.desc: Peppa on armas ja alati rõõmsameelne põrsaplika, kes elab koos oma väikese venna George'i, Emme Põssa ja Issi Põssaga. Peppale meeldib mängida, end põnevalt riidesse panna, väljas käia ja mudalompides hüpata. Ta seiklused lõpevad alati õnnelikult ja suure naeruga.

programme.title: Mina ja Miia
programme.desc: Miia ja Carina lähevad päästma vanasse majja kinni jäänud pistrikku. Kohapeal kohtuvad nad Pieteri ja Mattisega, kes kaaluvad maja ostmist. Tsentoopias valmistutakse otsustavaks lahinguks: Tessandra üritab võlusegu kokku segada, kuid kahjuks pääseb Gargoona neile ligi ja annab isand Drakonile haldjate plaanidest teada.

programme.title: Floor paneb reeglid paika
programme.desc: Floori sõbranna ema on veendunud, et Floori auraga on kehvad lood ja veab ta auratervendaja juurde.

programme.title: Lucas
programme.desc: Lucas ei suuda enam oma uut perekonda taluda ja otsustab veeta nädalavahetuse papsi pool... ilma papsita.

programme.title: Polly
programme.desc: Südamlik kogupere film räägib tüdrukust, kes päästab sõprade abiga tsirkusest shetlandi poni. Imeline lugu sõprusest, suvine Prantsusmaa ja vahvad tegelased. Film sobib vaatamiseks kõigile looduse- ja loomasõpradele. Peaosades Julie Gayet ja François Cluzet ("1+1"). Filmi režissöör Nicolas Vanier on juba tuntud loomafilmide ekspert ja looja. Tema filmidest oli viimati Eesti kinodes "Belle ja Sebastian".

programme.title: Homme põgeneme
programme.desc: Marta, Tobias, Ekke ja Rosabella piiravad sisse härra Manfredi, et temalt metsas toimuva kohta rohkem infot saada. Jõutakse arusaamisele, et must arheoloog peab olema keegi laagrist. Marta, Ekke, Tobias ja Rosabella hakkavad jälgima ja kahtlustama kõiki laagri täiskasvanuid. Lapsed, kellega on nüüd liitunud ka Eva, peidavad end öiste pidustuste ajal Rixi bemmi. Režissöör Kaire Russ, tootja Kassikuld OÜ.

programme.title: Gorilla gorilla gorilla
programme.desc: Gaboni Loango rahvuspark on osa maailma suurimast vihmametsast ja koduks rannikugorilladele (Gorilla gorilla gorilla), kes on neid paar aastakümmet uurinud bioloogidega ammu harjunud. Esimeses dokumentaalfilmis neist lummavatest olenditest on peategelasteks Kamaya ja tema pere oma argitoimetustes, aga ka teadlased, metsaelevandid, pühvlid ning viimased metsikud rannikud Aafrika troopikas.

programme.title: Eesti lood
programme.desc: Dokumentaalfilm jälgib Ailit, Alo, Ivo ja Linust, kelle elu on puudutanud kokkupuude anomaalsete nähtustega. Nende lood viivad Eesti unenäolistele ääremaadele, kus argine põimub paranormaalsega. Filmi keskmes on inimlik soov mõista nähtamatut ja kuulata neid, kelle kogemusi sageli eiratakse. See on rahulik ja inimlik teekond tundmatu piirile, mis ei otsi tõestust, vaid püüab mõista, mida tähendab uskuda seda, mida teised ei näe. Režissöörid Johan Huimerind, Sten Haljak, produtsendid Maie Rosmann, Johan Huimerind. Tootja Ilmatar Film.

programme.title: Piirideta põlvkond
programme.desc: Dokumentaalsari noortest eestlastest, kes on eri põhjustel valinud elutee väljaspool Eestit. Minisari portreteerib põlvkonda, kes astus ellu pärast Eesti liitumist Euroopa Liiduga, leides eest avatud piiridega maailma, kus mõneks ajaks välismaale tööle, õppima või seiklema minek tundus loomuliku ja põneva väljakutsena. Aastad hiljem ei ole tagasipöördumine Eestisse aga enam sugugi lihtne. Tihti kujunevad uues elukohas atraktiivsed karjääriperspektiivid ja paremad elutingimused, tekkinud on ka olulised lähedased suhted. Inimesed armuvad ja abielluvad, leiavad uusi mugavustsoone ning viise, kuidas neist jälle välja astuda. "Piirideta põlvkond" toob vaatajani ausad ja avatud lood värvikate elusaatustega eestlastest, kes elavad kokku neljateistkümnes eri riigis üle maailma. Osalejad jagavad oma isiklikke kogemusi, mõtteid ja tundeid seoses rände, kuuluvuse ja juurtega. Nende lugudest koorub põlvkondlik portree piiriülesest identiteedist, mis jääb Eestiga ometi sügavalt seotuks. Režissöör, stsenarist ja produtsent Terje Toomistu. Tootja Cece.

Film on dubleeritud eesti keelde dubleerimisstuudios Orbital Vox Stuudiod. Dublaažiprodutsent on Mari Randmäe, dublaaži- ja helirežissöör Andres Nõlvak. Eesti keelde tõlkinud Piret Õunapuu.

programme.desc: Kosmoseteemalise telesarja tegelased peavad hakkama oma rolle kehastama päris elus, sest nende abi vajavad tulnukad. Koos tuleb neil kaitsta Maad ja tulnukaid reptiilist sõjapealiku eest.

programme.title: Draakon Bruce Lee lugu
programme.desc: Film põhineb võitluskunstide superstaari elulool.

programme.title: Võmmipesa
programme.desc: USA 1997 krimidraama Lavastaja: James Mangold Osades: Sylvester Stallone, Michael Rappaport, Harvey Keitel, Ray Liotta, Robert De Niro, Peter Berg 1280 elanikuga Carrisoni nimeline väikelinnake on eriline. Selle elanikud on kõik politseinikud koos oma peredega, kes siin väljateenitud rahu naudivad. Kuid mustad ärid ei ole jätnud ka seda kohta puutumata, sest linnakest finantseerib maffia. Kui noor politseinik Murray Babitch (Michael Rappaport) kaks relvastamat mustanahalist maha laseb, ilmub kohale sisejuurdluse agent Moe Tilden (Robert DeNiro). Ta peab rinda pistma poolkurdi hädavaresest ðerif Garrison Freddy Hefliniga (Sylvester Stallone), kes näeb esimest korda võimalust kaotaja rollist loobuda, kuid tunneb ka lojaalsust kaaselanike ja nende juhi Ray Donlani vastu (Harvey Keitel).

programme.title: Õuduse õppetund
programme.desc: Kamp Harringtoni kolledži tudengeid teeb õõvastava avastuse - nende õppejõud ei ole need, kellena end esitlevad. Rivaalitsevatel noortel tuleb ühendada jõud ja hakata koostööd tegema.

programme.title: John Wick
programme.desc: USA 2014 põnevus Lavastaja:Chad Stahelski Osades:Keanu Reeves, Alfie Allen, Adrianne Paliciki Endine palgamõrtsukas loobub ajutiselt pensionipõlvest, et leida üles gangsterid, kes röövisid talt kõik. New Yorki kuulidest pikitud mänguväljakuna kasutav John Wick (Keanu Reeves) loob "palgamõrtsuka þanri" värske ja stiliseeritud versiooni.

programme.title: Kuuvalgus
programme.desc: "Kuuvalgus" on ajatu lugu inimsuhetest ja eneseleidmisest. See jälgib Miami karmis naabruskonnas elava mustanahalise noormehe elu lapsepõlvest täiskasvanuks saamiseni ning tema katsumusi maailmas oma koha leidmisel. Murrangulise kinoteosena on "Kuuvalgus" üheaegselt nii elav portree tänapäeva afroameeriklaste elust kui ka sügavalt isiklik lugu isiksusest, perekonnast, sõprusest ja armastusest. Näitlejate imelised esitused annavad lisajõudu Jenkinsi liigutavale kujutusele hetkedest, inimestest ja tundmatutest jõududest, mis teevad meist need, kes oleme.

programme.title: Teekond mälestustesse
programme.desc: Kooli kõige popim õpilane, pahapoiss ja tütarlaste lemmik, peab karistuseks tegema ühiksondlikult kasulikku tööd - aitama korraldada koolinäidendit. Üksi ei saa sa selle ülesandega hakkama.

programme.title: K-Pax
programme.desc: Salapärane vaimuhaigla patsient väidab, et ta on pärit planeedilt nimega K-Pax. Samalajal, kui psühhiaater püüab nuputada, kuidas patsienti aidata, avastab üks haigla arstidest, et see niinimetatud tulnukas avaldab suurt mõju teistele patsientidele ja nende vaimsele tervisele. Olles algselt kindel, et patsiendil on lihtsalt peas midagi korrast ära, hakkavad arstid enda diagnosides nüüd kahtlema.

programme.title: Sügis New Yorgis
programme.desc: Romantiline draama jõukast naistekütist (Richard Gere), kel tekib suhe endast poole noorema kaunitariga (Winona Ryder). Will plaanib Charlotte pärast esimest ühist ööd hüljata, kuid siis avaldab naine talle ehmatava saladuse - ta põeb eluohtlikku vähki. See valus pihtimus annab nende suhtele täiesti ootamatu pöörde.

programme.title: Valge oleander
programme.desc: Teismelise neiu ema läheb kiremõrva eest vangi ja tütarlaps satub ühest kasuperest teise.

programme.title: Rent
programme.desc: Film põhineb Puccini ooperil "Boheem" ja jutustab ühest aastast boheemlasliku sõpruskonna elust kaasaja New York City East Village'is aastatel 1989-

programme.title: Tristan ja Isolde
programme.desc: Film põhineb keskaegsel romantilisel legendil kuningatütar Isolde ja ülla rüütli Tristani ebamaisest armastusest. Tristan ohverdab oma tunded rahu ja ühtsuse nimel.

programme.title: Teekond mälestustesse
programme.desc: Kooli kõige popim õpilane, pahapoiss ja tütarlaste lemmik, peab karistuseks tegema ühiksondlikult kasulikku tööd - aitama korraldada koolinäidendit. Üksi ei saa sa selle ülesandega hakkama.

programme.title: Printsessist pruut
programme.desc: Vanaisa vestab lapselastele imelise muinasjutu armunutest, kelle saatus teineteisest lahku viis. Kuid ttõeline armastus võidab alati!

programme.title: Tugev kantri
programme.desc: Oscari-võitja Gwyneth Paltrow kehastab kantrilauljat filmis, mis kandideeris tema esitatud filmi tunnuslooga Oscarile.

programme.title: Frida
programme.desc: Tagasihoidlikku päritolu Frida Kahlo sai kuulsaks kui unikaalse nägemusega kunstnik. Alates pikast sõprusest oma mentori ja abikaasa Diego Riveraga kuni skandaalsete afäärideni on tema kompromissitu isiksus inspireerinud tema parimat loomingut.

programme.title: Elizabeth
programme.desc: Inglismaa kuulsaima kuninganna Elizabeth I (1533-1603) võimule tõusmise ja enesekehtestamise lugu. Elizabethi tee troonile oli käänuline. Henri VIII tütrena kuulutati ta vahepeal ikkagi vallaslapseks ja ta pidi oma nooruse veetma maapaos. Kuningas pärandas trooni oma põdurale pojale Edward VI-le, tolle surma järel tõusis korraks võimule Jane Grey, kuid tema elu lõppes tapalaval ja võim liikus edasi Elizabethi poolõe Mary I kätte, kes jõudis troonil olla ainult viis aastat. 1559. aastal, pärast heitlikke aegu, krooniti kuningannaks 25-aastane Elizabeth. Temast sai Tudorite dünastia viies ja viimane valitseja, kelle 44-aastast võimuaega meenutatakse siiani kui kuldajastut. Just Elizabeth I ajal sai Inglismaast võimas mere- ja koloniaalriik. Film keskendub Elizabethi esimestele valitsemisaastatele ja jälgib tema küpsemist kogenud juhiks. Noor naine peab valima isiklike tunnete ja riigi käekäiku määravate otsuste vahel, selleks tuleb tal aga kõigepealt oma ebakindlusest üle saada. Külluslik, pinev ja kohati sünge kostüümidraama tegi nimiosa täitnud noorukesest austraallannast Cate Blanchettist filmtähe ning tõi talle ka parima naisnäitleja Kuldgloobuse. Seitse Oscari nominatsiooni, kuldmehike võideti parima jumestuse eest.

programme.title: Mässajate tänav
programme.desc: 1950ndatel Connecticuti osariigi äärelinnas elanud noorpaar on hädas isiklike probleemidega, püüdes samal ajal kaht last kasvatada.

programme.title: Inglise patsient
programme.desc: 9 Oscarit võitnud (sh parim film) romantiline draama krahv Almasy (Ralph Fiennes) ja abielunaise Katharine'i (Kristin Scott Thomas) keelatud armastusest. Krahv saab tellimuse kaardistada täies ulatuses Sahara kõrb. Kuid kui algab Teine maailmasõda, tulistatakse ta lennuk alla ning mees saab üliraskeid põletushaavu. Tundmatu piloodina viiakse ta Itaaliasse, kus tema eest hakkab hoolitsema meditsiiniõde Hana (Juliette Binoche). Kild killu haaval hakkab Almasy lugu Hana ees lahti rulluma…

programme.title: Suhtekunst
programme.desc: Romantiline komöödia. Täiesti juhuslikult põrkavad tänavanurgal kokku kunstiajaloo professor Harper ja varjatud kunstiannetega Tom. Lööb sädemeid ja sõlmitakse tutvust. Tom hakkab Harperi koerakesega jalutusringe tegema, kuid peagi selgub, et Tomis on palju enamat peidus, mis naist köidab. Ühised teemad lähendavad Harperit ja Tomi ning ühel hetkel ei suuda nad enam teineteisele mõtlemata olla.

programme.title: James May: meie mees Jaapanis
programme.desc: James May on avastamas Sitsiilia päikeselisi randu, kus kultuurid Etna mäe varjus kokku põrkuvad. Ta saab kogeda selliseid ajatuid naudinguid nagu skulptuuritükkide hakkimine, kanuupolo ja torupill.

programme.title: Suvereporter+
programme.desc: Suvine uudistemagasin liigub sinna, kus Eesti suvi parajasti kõige elavamalt keeb. Saade toob vaatajani päeva olulisemad sündmused, värvikad inimesed ja meeleolukad lood rannast, linnamelust, festivalidelt, külapidudelt, aga ka Meediamaja rõdult.

programme.title: Suvi Maltal
programme.desc: Franka tuleb Vallettasse, et veenda sealse keeltekooli uut juhti kaasaegses ja keerukas õppesüsteemis, mis on ülemaailmse keelekooli "Talk to Me" edu aluseks. Kuid John eelistab keeli õpetada olukorrast lähtuvalt ega karda Franka pingutuste takistamiseks testidega manipuleerimist. Õnneks on tal Maltal ka sõbralikumaid kohtumisi.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Käpapatrull
programme.desc: Käpa-Patrull on eelkooliealiste sari, peaosas grupp kangelaslikke kutsikaid: Chase, Marshall, Rocky, Zuma, Rubble ja Skye, keda juhib 10-aastane tehnikataibuga poiss Ryder. Olles unikaalne segu probleemide lahendamise oskustest, ägedatest sõidukitest ja armsast rohkest kutsahuumorist, teeb Käpa-Patrull koostööd ülitähtsatel päästeoperatsioonidel, et kaitsta Seiklustelahe kogukonda. Tuletõrjekoer Marshallist politseikoer Chase'ini, ja Skye'ni, kes lendab kõrgelt oma helikopteriga, näitavad nad tiimitöö ja hea kodakondsuse tähtsust. Neil kõigil on seljas omaenda eriline Kutsakott, mis aitab neil kõigega toime tulla - kassipoegade aitamisest rongi päästmiseni kalju äärelt! Ja pole vahet kui suur on seiklus, Käpa-Patrullil on alati aega mänguks, naeruks ja üheks kõrvasügamiseks Ryderilt. Lõbus Käpa-Patrulli fakt: Ryder päästis kõik need kutsad ja õpetas neile nende Käpa-Patrulli oskused.

programme.title: Kidzone lastehommik _ Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi. Koos oma sõbra, roosa meritähe Patrickuga, satub ta kõige hullumeelsematesse ja põnevamatesse seiklustesse. Käsna-Kallel on väga energiline ja optimistlik iseloom, ning ta töötab kokana restoranis Krõbe Krabi, kus valmistab merepõhja parimaid burgereid.

programme.desc: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks on animafilmisari, mille peaosas on kollane merikäsn Käsna-Kalle, kes elab ookeanisügavustes veealuses linnas, mille nimi on Bikiini Põhi.
